scope: V12 Walker2d-morph medium to medium, 15 formal jobs

ROOT.weights: verify seed independence, compute once from fixed data, share SHA-256 across all seeds
ROOT.weight_description: full canonical row alignment vs stage 2, raw/normalized/clipped quantiles and Pearson correlation, clipping fraction

H_root.baseline: higher Last5 mean of T and BC-all
H_root.support: delta >= 5 and delta > 2*SE and (T not baseline or positive paired count >= 4)

GPU: select one verified RTX A6000 from the explicitly registered subset of physical GPU 0–3, then hold its UUID for all jobs

GPU_occupancy_policy.preference: idle cards first, then fewest visible PIDs, lower utilization, lower memory, lower index
GPU_occupancy_policy.idle: zero percent utilization, at most 3 MiB memory, no visible processes
GPU_occupancy_policy.shared: at most two visible existing GPU processes, no more than one new worker, utilization at most 60%, per-process memory accounted within 256 MiB
GPU_occupancy_policy.scheduler_limit: check total process slots before release; other users can launch independently, so site registration still applies

CPU_probe: one real 128+128 batch, stage 2 checkpoint and weights, no optimizer or environment, prior to GPU jobs
recovery: explicit manual restart by logical seed; reuse only fully verified results, audit complete unaudited workers on CPU in the new output, rerun interrupted seeds from zero, preserve prior outputs and the prior physical GPU once released
